$Comment: The short heal a dungeon checkpoint (the ZigCheckpoint trigger-volume effect) gives every member of the run when one of them reaches it. Everything but its length comes from the game's own checkpoint heal, Dungeon_Checkpoint_Heal (its rate, green tint, sound and icon); this holds it for 8 seconds. Raise Duration for a longer heal, or point a checkpoint's HealEffect at an effect of your own.
